population.span: Patients in New York Heart Association (NYHA) functional class II to IV, with a LVEF of 40% or less and an elevated N-terminal pro–B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-pro-BNP) concentration, were eligible for study inclusion if receiving standard pharmacological and device therapy.

treatment_strategy.span: we randomly assigned 4744 patients with New York Heart Association class II, III, or IV heart failure and an ejection fraction of 40% or less to receive either dapagliflozin (at a dose of 10 mg once daily) or placebo, in addition to recommended therapy.
